package repository

import "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"

type GeneratedCourseRepository interface {
	Lock(ctx Context, scope string, key string) error
	GetRequest(ctx Context, idempotencyKey string) (domain.GeneratedCourseRequest, error)
	GetCourseIDByFingerprint(ctx Context, origin string, fingerprintVersion string, fingerprint string) (string, error)
	CreateCourseRecord(ctx Context, record domain.GeneratedCourseRecord) error
	CreateLessonRecord(ctx Context, record domain.GeneratedLessonRecord) error
	CreateRequest(ctx Context, request domain.GeneratedCourseRequest) error
	ListLessonBindings(ctx Context, courseID string) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error)
}
